summary: The concrete blocker is unauthorized applied symmetric literal/idiomatic repairs r0033–r0049. Each owner proposal exactly matches the applied extraction.translationRepairs tuple (before, after, reason) and is grounded in the cited 舊五代史 clauses. Independent accept decisions for those seventeen IDs close the supplemental-repair gap without touching r0001–r0032. One prior editorial claim revision (c1456 under r0011) still fails native closure because its recorded after still carries a stale westernInterval 915–917 while the pinned extraction and audited date report retain the approved one-sided westernBounds on-or-before AD 917 for 劉鄩失律.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 貞明三年春正月戊午，以前淄州刺史高允奇為右羽林統軍。
approvedChanges.note: 刺史 as Inspector and 羽林 as Feathered Forest; matches applied extraction contract.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 二月甲申，晉王攻我黎陽，劉鄩拒之而退。
approvedChanges.note: 劉鄩 is Liu Xun (鄩), not Liu Zhen.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 二月甲申，晉王攻我黎陽，劉鄩拒之而退。
approvedChanges.note: Same person reading; idiomatic action rendering is source-faithful.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 丁亥，以前右羽林軍統軍梁繼業為左衛上將軍。
approvedChanges.note: 右羽林軍統軍 is Right Feathered Forest commander, not Forest-Unicorn.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 丁亥，以前右羽林軍統軍梁繼業為左衛上將軍。
己亥，以啟聖匡運同德功臣、諸道兵馬元帥、淮南鎮海鎮東等軍節度使、充淮南宣潤等四面行營都統、開府儀同三司、尚書令、吳越王錢鏐為天下兵馬元帥。
approvedChanges.note: 開府儀同三司 is open office rank equal to Three Excellencies; 尚書令 as President of State Affairs is acceptable for the long title chain around Qian Liu.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 宰臣敬翔奏曰：「國家自劉鄩失律以來，府藏殫竭，箕斂百姓，供軍不暇，郊祀之禮，頒行賞賚，所謂取虛名而受實弊也。
approvedChanges.note: 劉鄩失律 attributes fiscal argument to Liu Xun; quotation correctly left open into s0054.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 壬寅，鎮海鎮東等軍節度行軍司馬、秦州節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事馬綽加檢校太尉、同平章事，依前鎮海、鎮東等軍節度行軍司馬，餘如故，從錢鏐之請也。
approvedChanges.note: 加檢校太尉 is honorary Grand Commandant (太尉), not Grand Preceptor.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 壬寅，鎮海鎮東等軍節度行軍司馬、秦州節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事馬綽加檢校太尉、同平章事，依前鎮海、鎮東等軍節度行軍司馬，餘如故，從錢鏐之請也。
己未，靈武節度使韓洙落起復，授開府儀同三司，依前檢校太傅、同平章事。
approvedChanges.note: 落起復 and 開府儀同三司 correctly rendered; 韓洙 as Han Zhu.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 己未，靈武節度使韓洙落起復，授開府儀同三司，依前檢校太傅、同平章事。
仍命劉鄩為兗州管內安撫製置使，領兵以攻之。
approvedChanges.note: 劉鄩 is Liu Xun; 仍命 is continuing appointment, not adverb still.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 仍命劉鄩為兗州管內安撫製置使，領兵以攻之。
approvedChanges.note: Symmetric Liu Xun and Yan pacification commissioner reading.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 是月，劉鄩攻下兗州，擒張守進，夷其族。
approvedChanges.note: 劉鄩 is Liu Xun; 攻下兗州 captured Yan Prefecture.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 是月，劉鄩攻下兗州，擒張守進，夷其族。
十一月丁丑，以兗州安撫製置使、特進、檢校太傅、大彭郡開國公劉鄩為兗州節度使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、同平章事，賞平兗之功也。
approvedChanges.note: Full title chain: Liu Xun, 開府儀同三司, 檢校太尉 as Grand Commandant.

approvedChanges.chineseExcerpt: 十一月丁丑，以兗州安撫製置使、特進、檢校太傅、大彭郡開國公劉鄩為兗州節度使、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、同平章事，賞平兗之功也。
approvedChanges.note: Restores omitted honors in idiomatic field; person and office readings align with source.
